mentions.name: blastersim
mentions.description: Open source simulator for Nerf blasters, supporting both spring and pneumatic blasters. Built with an object-oriented architecture where a blaster is assembled from control volumes and connections between them, letting the same core framework model different blaster configurations and variants, such as a spring piston pulling a vacuum on its back side when flow is insufficient. The core simulator works, but a user interface and documentation are still pending; text input files are planned first, possibly with a GUI later. Work is currently focused on testing.
